CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
13) 'Read the story and number the paragraphs in the correct order, then answer the questions.' HIKOYA 'Diamonds are a Girl's Best Friend' (pushti qog'oz, a-d katakchali): [a] 'Pam screamed when she saw the man running past her. Suddenly he slipped on the wet pavement and fell to the ground. Pam quickly picked up the bag that had fallen from the man's hand and pulled off his mask. At that moment the police arrived.' [b] 'Three hours later, Pam was walking home when a man stopped her. It was the man she had seen chasing the thief out of the shop. "Miss Brown? I'm Hans VanBurg. I just wanted to thank you for your bravery," he said. "Here, this is for you." He handed Pam a small velvet case. Inside it was a beautiful diamond necklace. "Oh, my goodness!" Pam said with a delighted smile on her face. "Dreams really can come true!"' [c] 'It was a cold, cloudy morning in October and Pam Brown was on her way to the supermarket. It had rained earlier, so the pavements were wet and slippery.' [d] 'Pam walked past all the expensive shops. She stopped in front of VanBurg Jewellers and admired the magnificent jewellery in the window. It had always been Pam's dream to own a diamond necklace. Suddenly, a man wearing a mask and carrying a bag ran out of the shop. Another man rushed out after him, shouting, "Stop that thief! Stop him!"'
  SAVOLLAR: 1 Why were the pavements slippery? 2 What was Pam's dream? 3 What did Pam do when the thief fell? 4 Who stopped Pam as she was walking home? Why? 5 How did Pam feel in the end?

O'NG USTUN - 'Writing (a story)':
14a) 'The pictures below show what happened to an explorer Nigel James and his parrot Polly while they were in the Amazon Rainforest last summer. Look at them and answer the questions.' 1 What is Nigel doing in picture a? 2 What is Nigel putting on in picture b? 3 Why is Nigel scared in picture c? 4 What is Polly doing in picture d? 5 How does Nigel feel in picture e? RASMLAR 'My Feathered Hero': a Nigel kulba oldida nonushta qilyapti (choy ichyapti), to'tiqush yonida; b Nigel shlyapa kiyyapti, Polly yelkasida; c Nigel qo'rqib turibdi, oldida ilon; d Polly ilonni tumshug'ida ko'tarib balandlikdan tashlayapti (aylanada); e Nigel Pollyga: 'You saved my life my friend.'
14b) 'Look at the pictures again. Use the prompts below to help you tell the story.' • hot summer morning - the Amazon Rainforest - Nigel & Polly have breakfast • Nigel decide - go for a walk - put on hat - Polly follow Nigel • dangerous snake - Nigel stand still - terrified • Polly pick up snake - drop snake from high above • Nigel relieved - Polly a hero.
14c) 'Use the prompts above and the plan below to write the story (120 - 180 words).' PLAN: Paras 1: who, when, where, what; Paras 2-3: events one after the other; Paras 4: end the story & people's feelings.

exercises.instructionEn: Diamonds are a Girl's Best Friend (paragraphs a-d, in the correct order: c, d, a, b)
exercises.instructionUz: Olmoslar - qizning eng yaqin do'sti (a-d xatboshilar, to'g'ri tartib: c, d, a, b)
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA - 'DIAMONDS ARE A GIRL'S
  BEST FRIEND'.

  ⚠ Sarlavha - Merilin Monro
  qo'shig'i nomi (1953).

TO'G'RI TARTIB:
  1 - c: BOShLANISh (qachon,
      qayerda, kim, ob-havo)
  2 - d: VOQEA (zargarlik do'koni,
      o'g'ri chiqdi)
  3 - a: KULMINATSIYA (o'g'ri
      yiqildi, Pam sumkani oldi)
  4 - b: YAKUN (mukofot - olmos
      marjon)


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  Past perfect - oldingi holat:
  'It HAD rained earlier', 'It HAD
  always been Pam's dream', 'the
  bag that HAD fallen', 'the man
  she HAD seen'.
  Past continuous - fon: 'was
  walking home when'.


⚠ 'SLIPPERY':

  = sirpanchiq.


⚠ 'A PAVEMENT':

  Brit. = piyodalar yo'lagi.


⚠ 'MAGNIFICENT':

  = ulug'vor, ajoyib.


⚠ 'BRAVERY':

  = jasorat.


⚠ 'A VELVET CASE':

  = baxmal quti (zargarlik uchun).


⚠ 'DREAMS CAN COME TRUE':

  = orzular ro'yobga chiqishi
  mumkin.

points.en: [c] It was a cold, cloudy morning in October and Pam Brown was on her way to the supermarket. It had rained earlier, so the pavements were wet and slippery.
points.uz: [c] Oktyabrning sovuq, bulutli tongi edi va Pam Braun supermarketga ketayotgan edi. Avvalroq yomg'ir yog'gan edi, shuning uchun yo'laklar ho'l va sirpanchiq edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 1-XATBOShI: boshlanish (qachon, kim, qayerda, ob-havo).
⚠ 'It had rained earlier' - oldingi holat.

points.en: [d] Pam walked past all the expensive shops. She stopped in front of VanBurg Jewellers and admired the magnificent jewellery in the window. It had always been Pam's dream to own a diamond necklace. Suddenly, a man wearing a mask and carrying a bag ran out of the shop. Another man rushed out after him, shouting, "Stop that thief! Stop him!"
points.uz: [d] Pam barcha qimmat do'konlar yonidan o'tdi. U VanBurg zargarlik do'koni oldida to'xtab, vitrinadagi ajoyib taqinchoqlarni tomosha qildi. Olmos marjonga ega bo'lish har doim Pamning orzusi edi. To'satdan niqob kiygan va sumka ko'targan bir odam do'kondan yugurib chiqdi. Boshqa bir odam uning orqasidan otilib chiqib qichqirdi: "O'g'rini to'xtating! Uni to'xtating!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 2-XATBOShI: voqea boshlanishi.
⚠ 'It had always been Pam's dream' - 2-savol javobi.

points.en: [a] Pam screamed when she saw the man running past her. Suddenly he slipped on the wet pavement and fell to the ground. Pam quickly picked up the bag that had fallen from the man's hand and pulled off his mask. At that moment the police arrived.
points.uz: [a] Pam odam yonidan yugurib o'tayotganini ko'rib qichqirdi. To'satdan u ho'l yo'lakda sirpanib yerga yiqildi. Pam tezda odamning qo'lidan tushib ketgan sumkani oldi va niqobini yechdi. Shu payt politsiya yetib keldi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 3-XATBOShI: kulminatsiya.
⚠ 3-savol javobi: sumkani oldi, niqobini yechdi.

points.en: [b] Three hours later, Pam was walking home when a man stopped her. It was the man she had seen chasing the thief out of the shop. "Miss Brown? I'm Hans VanBurg. I just wanted to thank you for your bravery," he said. "Here, this is for you." He handed Pam a small velvet case. Inside it was a beautiful diamond necklace. "Oh, my goodness!" Pam said with a delighted smile on her face. "Dreams really can come true!"
points.uz: [b] Uch soatdan keyin Pam uyga ketayotganida bir odam uni to'xtatdi. Bu o'g'rini do'kondan quvib chiqqanini ko'rgan o'sha odam edi. "Miss Braun? Men Hans VanBurgman. Jasoratingiz uchun rahmat aytmoqchi edim," dedi u. "Mana, bu siz uchun." U Pamga kichik baxmal quti uzatdi. Ichida go'zal olmos marjon bor edi. "Voy, xudoyim!" dedi Pam yuzida xursand tabassum bilan. "Orzular chindan ham ro'yobga chiqar ekan!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 4-XATBOShI: yakun va his-tuyg'ular.
⚠ 4-5-savollar javobi: Hans VanBurg (do'kon egasi), Pam xursand (delighted).

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures below show what happened to an explorer Nigel James and his parrot Polly while they were in the Amazon Rainforest last summer. Look at them and answer the questions. (a Nigel having breakfast outside a hut; b Nigel putting on his hat, Polly on his shoulder; c Nigel scared, a snake in front of him; d Polly carrying the snake and dropping it from high above; e Nigel to Polly: 'You saved my life my friend.')
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlar sayyoh Nigel Jeyms va uning to'tiqushi Polli o'tgan yozda Amazonka tropik o'rmonida bo'lganida nima bo'lganini ko'rsatadi. Ularga qarab savollarga javob bering. (a Nigel kulba oldida nonushta qilyapti; b Nigel shlyapa kiyyapti, Polli yelkasida; c Nigel qo'rqib turibdi, oldida ilon; d Polli ilonni ko'tarib balanddan tashlayapti; e Nigel Polliga: 'Sen hayotimni saqlab qolding, do'stim.')
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR - 'MY FEATHERED HERO'
  (Mening patli qahramonim).

  a nonushta (present continuous:
    is having)
  b shlyapa (is putting on)
  c ilon - qo'rquv (because there
    is a snake)
  d Polly ilonni ko'tarib tashlayapti
  e yengil tortgan, minnatdor


⚠ 'AN EXPLORER':

  = sayyoh-tadqiqotchi.


⚠ 'A PARROT':

  = to'tiqush.


⚠ 'FEATHERED':

  = patli. 'a feather' = pat.


⚠ 'THE AMAZON RAINFOREST':

  = Amazonka tropik o'rmoni.

items.answer: He feels relieved and grateful - Polly saved his life.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts and the plan below to write the story (120 - 180 words). Prompts: hot summer morning - the Amazon Rainforest - Nigel & Polly have breakfast; Nigel decide - go for a walk - put on hat - Polly follow Nigel; dangerous snake - Nigel stand still - terrified; Polly pick up snake - drop snake from high above; Nigel relieved - Polly a hero. PLAN: Para 1: who, when, where, what; Paras 2-3: events one after the other; Para 4: end the story & people's feelings.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar va quyidagi reja asosida hikoyani yozing (120-180 so'z). Ko'rsatmalar: issiq yoz tongi - Amazonka tropik o'rmoni - Nigel va Polli nonushta; Nigel sayrga chiqishga qaror qildi - shlyapa kiydi - Polli ergashdi; xavfli ilon - Nigel qotib qoldi - dahshatga tushdi; Polli ilonni ko'tardi - balanddan tashladi; Nigel yengil tortdi - Polli qahramon. REJA: 1-xatboshi: kim, qachon, qayerda, nima; 2-3-xatboshilar: ketma-ket voqealar; 4-xatboshi: yakun va his-tuyg'ular.

structure.modelEn: It was a hot summer morning in the Amazon Rainforest. Nigel James, an explorer, was having breakfast outside his hut with his parrot, Polly. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.
structure.modelUz: Amazonka tropik o'rmonida issiq yoz tongi edi. Sayyoh Nigel Jeyms to'tiqushi Polli bilan kulbasi oldida nonushta qilayotgan edi. Quyosh porlab, qushlar sayrayotgan edi.

structure.modelEn: After he had finished his breakfast, Nigel decided to go for a walk in the forest. He put on his hat and set off. Polly followed him, flying from tree to tree.
structure.modelUz: Nonushtasini tugatgach, Nigel o'rmonda sayr qilishga qaror qildi. U shlyapasini kiyib yo'lga chiqdi. Polli daraxtdan daraxtga uchib unga ergashdi.

structure.modelEn: Suddenly, Nigel saw a dangerous snake in front of him. He stood still. He was terrified! Just then, Polly flew down, picked up the snake in her beak and dropped it from high above. The snake disappeared into the trees.
structure.modelUz: To'satdan Nigel oldida xavfli ilonni ko'rdi. U qimirlamay turdi. U dahshatga tushgan edi! Shu payt Polli pastga uchib kelib, ilonni tumshug'iga oldi va balanddan tashladi. Ilon daraxtlar orasiga g'oyib bo'ldi.

structure.modelEn: Nigel felt very relieved. "You saved my life, my friend," he said to Polly. From that day on, Nigel never went anywhere without his feathered hero.
structure.modelUz: Nigel juda yengil tortdi. "Sen hayotimni saqlab qolding, do'stim," dedi u Polliga. O'sha kundan boshlab Nigel patli qahramonisiz hech qayerga bormaydigan bo'ldi.

modelAnswers:
My Feathered Hero

It was a hot summer morning in the Amazon Rainforest. Nigel James, an explorer, was having breakfast outside his hut with his parrot, Polly. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.

After he had finished his breakfast, Nigel decided to go for a walk in the forest. He put on his hat and set off. Polly followed him, flying from tree to tree.

Suddenly, Nigel saw a dangerous snake in front of him. He stood still. He was terrified! Just then, Polly flew down, picked up the snake in her beak and dropped it from high above. The snake disappeared into the trees.

Nigel felt very relieved. "You saved my life, my friend," he said to Polly. From that day on, Nigel never went anywhere without his feathered hero.
modelAnswersUz:
Mening patli qahramonim

Amazonka tropik o'rmonida issiq yoz tongi edi. Sayyoh Nigel Jeyms to'tiqushi Polli bilan kulbasi oldida nonushta qilayotgan edi. Quyosh porlab, qushlar sayrayotgan edi.

Nonushtasini tugatgach, Nigel o'rmonda sayr qilishga qaror qildi. U shlyapasini kiyib yo'lga chiqdi. Polli daraxtdan daraxtga uchib unga ergashdi.

To'satdan Nigel oldida xavfli ilonni ko'rdi. U qimirlamay turdi. U dahshatga tushgan edi! Shu payt Polli pastga uchib kelib, ilonni tumshug'iga oldi va balanddan tashladi. Ilon daraxtlar orasiga g'oyib bo'ldi.

Nigel juda yengil tortdi. "Sen hayotimni saqlab qolding, do'stim," dedi u Polliga. O'sha kundan boshlab Nigel patli qahramonisiz hech qayerga bormaydigan bo'ldi.

patterns.formula: It had + V3 earlier, so + NATIJA.
patterns.exampleEn: It had rained earlier, so the pavements were wet and slippery.
patterns.exampleUz: Avvalroq yomg'ir yog'gan edi, shuning uchun yo'laklar ho'l va sirpanchiq edi.

patterns.formula: It had always been X's dream to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: It had always been Pam's dream to own a diamond necklace.
patterns.exampleUz: Olmos marjonga ega bo'lish har doim Pamning orzusi edi.

patterns.formula: X was + V-ing when Y + V2. It was the man she had + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: Pam was walking home when a man stopped her. It was the man she had seen chasing the thief.
patterns.exampleUz: Pam uyga ketayotganida bir odam uni to'xtatdi. Bu o'g'rini quvganini ko'rgan o'sha odam edi.

patterns.formula: You saved my life, my friend.
patterns.exampleEn: "You saved my life, my friend," he said to Polly.
patterns.exampleUz: "Sen hayotimni saqlab qolding, do'stim," dedi u Polliga.
